mentions.name: Website integrity and security monitor
mentions.description: A website integrity and security monitor that scans sites for accessibility issues (missing alt text, form labels, heading hierarchy, lang attribute), content policy violations, performance problems (load time, excessive inline JS/styles), security risks (SSL expiry, security headers, revealing Server header), SEO gaps (missing title/meta description, multiple H1s), site integrity (broken links, deprecated tags, insecure http links), and spelling errors. Built with a Java/PostgreSQL backend and a JS/React front end, usable interactively via the front end or API-driven, delivered as a fully self-service product targeting a June launch.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a website integrity and security monitor. The backend is written in Java/PostgreSQL. The front end is written in JS/React. It will allow for interactive use via front end or be API driven.
